# Validation Operational Checklist

## Preconditions

- Confirm accepted preparation artifacts, selected IaC binding, target, and
  acceptance criteria belong to the active run before reading validation proof.
- Use only kernel-projected or trusted capability evidence. A local file,
  remembered command result, or chat statement cannot replace accepted proof.
- Keep unavailable, failed, incomplete, stale, and scope-mismatched checks
  distinct; none may be restated as a passed criterion.

## Coverage

- Evaluate generated-tree validation, build, security, governance, functional,
  and deployment-readiness criteria against their declared evidence scope.
- Require each accepted result to identify its target, artifact revision,
  observation time, outcome, and remaining limits.
- When a failure changes intent, inputs, or IaC bindings, route it to the
  owning preparation task and require renewed validation evidence.

## Handoff

Only a complete accepted validation result may advance to the kernel-selected
next task. This skill neither changes lifecycle state nor invokes deployment.
